# Nincada L.20, twice: "Yes" to its own prompt evolves it into Ninjask and
# draws Random(4) for Shedinja; "No" falls through to the generic prompt,
# where "Yes" evolves it without the Shedinja draw.
party 290 20
party 290 20
> start
> seed 23
> menu Actions > Evolve a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to evolve it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Evolution Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> answer yes
> choose 1
dialog information "# 290 Nincada, L.20, XP:8000, XP to next level:1261" -> OK
dialog confirmation "Your Nincada can evolve into Ninjask. Do you want to evolve it? NOTE: Nincada will evolve into Ninjask AND Shedinja every 3 of 4 times." -> Yes
dialog information "Nincada evolved into Ninjask!" -> OK
rand 4 = 2
dialog information "Nincada also evolved into Shedinja!" -> OK
log Shedinja has been added to the POKéDEX!
> menu Actions > Evolve a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to evolve it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Evolution Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> answer no yes
> choose 2
dialog information "# 290 Nincada, L.20, XP:8000, XP to next level:1261" -> OK
dialog confirmation "Your Nincada can evolve into Ninjask. Do you want to evolve it? NOTE: Nincada will evolve into Ninjask AND Shedinja every 3 of 4 times." -> No
dialog confirmation "Your Nincada can evolve into Ninjask. Do you want to evolve it?" -> Yes
dialog information "Nincada evolved into Ninjask!" -> OK
> state
state battle wild=0 trainer=0 tournament=0 type=0 own=0 hp=0 enemy=0 level=0 hp=0 levels=2-100
state player badges=0 Money=0 Wins=0 Losses=0 Fights=0 Catches=0 PokeBalls=3 GreatBalls=0 UltraBalls=0 MasterBalls=0 Potions=0 SuperPotions=0 flags=
state dex 290,291,292
state party 1:291/L20/8000 2:291/L20/8000 3:292/L20/8000
> quit
exit 0
save line 310: "FALSE" -> "TRUE"
save line 311: "FALSE" -> "TRUE"
save line 406: "290" -> "291"
save line 409: "290" -> "291"
save line 412: "0" -> "292"
save line 413: "0" -> "20"
save line 414: "0" -> "8000"
